answer: Grade every agent onto a terrace of depth-tiered ledges, where the lowest ledge is crowded and the highest is nearly empty. To climb a tier a head must present an onyx seal minted by a quorum drawn only from the tier directly below, and each lender may issue at most one seal per epoch. A vault holds the seal until the head has spent a full epoch on the lower ledge, so a sybil fleet cannot mint seals in parallel: each one needs vouchers that are themselves rate-limited and traceable to real prior work.
